turn_on.name: Turn on
turn_on.description: Turn on the targeted entities, skipping any that are already on. Works across all on/off-capable domains.

turn_off.name: Turn off
turn_off.description: Turn off the targeted entities, skipping any that are already off. Works across all on/off-capable domains.

cover_safe_open.name: Open cover (safe)
cover_safe_open.description: Open the targeted covers, skipping any already fully open (no redundant relay click).

cover_safe_close.name: Close cover (safe)
cover_safe_close.description: Close the targeted covers, skipping any already fully closed (no redundant relay click).

cover_safe_set_position.name: Set cover position (safe)
cover_safe_set_position.description: Set the targeted covers to a position, skipping any already at that position.

cover_safe_set_tilt_position.name: Set cover tilt (safe)
cover_safe_set_tilt_position.description: Set the targeted covers to a tilt position, skipping any already at that tilt.
